task: Choose one of four explicit structured actions satisfying stated facts; exactly one feasible option
test_scope: New synthetic benchmark test, not locked product test
labels: Deterministic verifier, not human conversation-quality labels
model_inputs: Only task instruction, facts and four actions; no split, ID, reward or correct index
universal_refusal: Refusal is not an action in this narrow task. This does not redefine the user policy that refusals can be good conversational replies.
limitations: Shared task families across splits; disjoint fact states/objects, not broad language generalization. Success does not establish better free-form STANDARD or LOCAL replies.
